jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager – Enterprise Transformation Programs
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

UiPath is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager with an uncommon profile: not a traditional CSM, but a transformation program leader able to act as a true strategic partner for one of our largest enterprise accounts.

Your mission is to drive this client’s automation journey — from RPA industrialization to emerging agentic use cases — by challenging their priorities, shaping a bold vision, and moving the needle where others would simply manage the relationship.

This role requires strong executive presence, the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics, and a genuine passion for transformation at scale.



What You'll Do

 - Own the transformation roadmap: Define and drive the client's automation strategy, from planning through value realization, coordinating across internal and external workstreams

 - Challenge and advise: Act as a trusted strategic advisor — push back when needed, propose a vision, and proactively identify new automation and agentic AI use cases

 - Orchestrate complex programs: Lead cross-functional initiatives across IT and business stakeholders in large, governance-heavy environments

 - Build C-suite relationships: Cultivate and sustain executive-level relationships, becoming the go-to partner on automation strategy and digital transformation

 - Drive value realization: Define, track, and communicate the business impact delivered through automation — and expand it

 - Stay ahead of the curve: Bring thought leadership on industry trends, emerging automation technologies, and AI-powered workflows



What You'll Bring

Required:

 - 8+ years of experience leading large-scale IT and/or AI transformation programs in complex enterprise environments — within large organizations or top-tier consulting firms

 - Deep understanding of IT operating models and governance, with a proven ability to manage cross-functional initiatives involving both IT and business stakeholders

 - Demonstrated capacity to challenge a client, defend a point of view, and navigate the political complexity of large organizations

 - Strong interest in public sector transformation

 - Autonomous, results-driven, with a natural leadership presence

 - Fluency in English & French

Nice to have:

 - Familiarity with the RPA/automation ecosystem or AI platforms

 - Experience in a SaaS or software vendor environment



#LI-CD3

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. jobs.title: Chief of Staff, GTM Americas
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




CHIEF OF STAFF, GTM AMERICAS




ABOUT THE JOB

UiPath is transforming how organizations work through automation and AI. As our Americas GTM organization continues to scale and evolve, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to help the President of Americas Sales increase the speed, focus, and effectiveness of the business.

The Chief of Staff will serve as the President’s operating partner and execution integrator. This role will help convert priorities into coordinated action, strengthen the operating rhythm of the organization, remove friction across teams and processes, and ensure that important decisions move quickly from discussion to execution.

The Americas GTM organization operates across multiple segments, industries, customer needs, and go-to-market teams. The successful candidate will help the organization respond more quickly to market changes, customer needs, product and portfolio evolution, and business priorities by ensuring that our teams are positioned to sell the breadth of UiPath’s offerings and deliver against our revenue commitments.

This role will work closely with the President’s Executive Assistant, HR Business Leader, GTM Strategy leader, and Americas leadership team. Each partner will bring distinct expertise; the Chief of Staff will connect those efforts and ensure the organization operates with clarity, urgency, and accountability.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Initiative portfolio and tracking. Build and run the Americas leadership team's long-running initiatives. Drive the coordination and follow through, and where needed fill the gaps with necessary problem solving and analysis.

Weekly intelligence and field communications. Keep pulse on the business by pulling together leadership meeting transcripts, Slack threads, deal and forecast reviews, and field feedback into the operating rhythms and communications with the field. Build this into an automated system vs. a manual chase.

Operating rhythm. Own the agenda, pre-reads, and follow-up for each forum including QBRs, leadership team cadence, important cross functional touchpoints, and decision forums.

Executive leverage systems. Design and build the tools that make the Americas team more efficient. Examples include automated briefing packs, meeting prep, initiative dashboards, and AI-assisted digests drawn from Slack, email, and meeting notes. The expectation is that the CoS builds these, not that they request them from another team.

Delegated initiatives and one-offs. Lead two or three named strategic initiatives at a time end to end on the President's behalf. Illustrative examples are a cross-functional sales play launch, an account-planning push, or customer consumption review cadence. Act as the intake point for one-off requests: triage each one, decide whether it belongs with the CoS, a functional owner, or nowhere, and track whatever is accepted to completion

Turn ambiguity and insights into a plan: Partner with the GTM Strategy leader to translate commercial priorities, insights, and changes in market execution into practical execution across the Americas organization.

Represent the President: Partner with the HR Business Leader and Executive assistant on the execution of the highest priorities, adoption of organizational changes, leadership transitions, and other business priorities, without owning the underlying people strategy. You will handle sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment,and maturity while anticipating what the organization will need next.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO OUR TEAM

 - 10+ years of experience in a Chief of Staff, business operations, consulting, Sales leadership, transformation, or comparable role within a complex organization.

 - Experience supporting a senior executive, preferably a Sales or GTM leader, in a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.

 - Strong understanding of how enterprise GTM organizations operate, including the connection between Sales, pre-sales, Customer Success, Partners, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Professional Services.

 - Demonstrated ability to improve operational rigor, simplify processes, remove organizational friction, and accelerate execution.

 - Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in which success depends on influence rather than formal authority.

 - Strong business judgment and the ability to quickly distinguish between issues that require executive action, cross-functional coordination, or local ownership.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and create clear recommendations for senior leaders.

 - A track record of building effective operating mechanisms without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

 - The ability to anticipate risks, connect dependencies, and drive sustained follow-through across multiple teams.

 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data, stakeholder input, and customer or field feedback to inform decisions and improve execution.

 - Executive presence, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build trust across a broad and diverse leadership group.

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity, urgency, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.

 - A practical, low-ego, highly collaborative approach, with the willingness to work across organizational boundaries to help the business move forward.

 - A genuine interest in how businesses evolve and improve, with the curiosity to test, learn, iterate, and continuously raise the effectiveness of the organization.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, success means the Americas GTM organization can move with greater speed, clarity, and coordination.

The Chief of Staff will help create:

 - Faster movement from decision to execution

 - Clearer ownership and stronger follow-through

 - Fewer internal bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs

 - More effective cross-functional collaboration

 - Earlier visibility to business risks and execution gaps

 - Faster organizational response to customer, market, product, and company changes

 - Stronger readiness to sell UiPath’s evolving portfolio and go-to-market motions

 - A leadership team that is focused on the highest-value priorities

 - An operating environment that can continuously learn, adapt, and improve

 - Greater capacity for the President and leadership team to focus on growth, customers, talent, and revenue performance



Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst, Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




ABOUT THE ROLE:



We are seeking a highly analytical, results-driven Senior FP&A Analyst to join our Corporate FP&A team. This role sits at the intersection of financial planning, investor relations analytics, and strategic finance, with direct exposure to M&A evaluation, capital markets communications, and top-line performance modeling for a public SaaS company. You will work closely with senior leadership and the CFO's office to shape how the company communicates its financial story to the Street, the Board, and prospective transaction counterparties.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AT UIPATH:



• Help design and maintain a long-term financial model projecting UiPath's future

fiscal year top-line metrics, including ARR movements such as new business,

expansion, contraction, and churn, with sensitivity analysis suitable for board and

investor scenarios.

• Build and refine SaaS valuation and benchmarking frameworks (ARR growth,

NRR/DBNRR, Rule of 40, magic number, CAC/LTV) to support investor relations

messaging and peer comparisons against public SaaS and enterprise software

comparables.

• Support M&A activity including target screening, financial due diligence,

accretion/dilution and synergy modeling, and integration of acquired ARR and

revenue streams into consolidated top-line forecasts.

• Create and implement innovative forecasting methodologies across a variety of top-

line models, adaptable to inorganic growth scenarios and changes in business mix.

• Analyze KPIs related to product and sales performance, developing new analyses to

assess business health and translate operating metrics into the language used by

equity analysts and institutional investors.

• Prepare board decks, earnings materials, and investor relations presentations,

working with IR and the CFO to ensure numbers translate cleanly into external

narrative on a monthly and quarterly cadence.

• Own quality assurance on all board-level and external financial communications,

ensuring consistency between internal models, public disclosures, and any

transaction-related materials.

• Partner cross-functionally with Corporate Development, Treasury, and Legal on

deal-related financial analysis as M&A opportunities arise.





WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TEAM:



• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or related field; 2-

4 years of relevant experience in FP&A, investment banking, equity research,

corporate development, or transaction advisory.

• Strong financial modeling skills, including exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR,

NRR/DBNRR, billings, FCF) and M&A analysis (valuation, accretion/dilution, synergy

modeling) a plus.

• Mastery of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint), with demonstrated ability to build

complex, audit-ready financial models under tight deadlines.

• Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to translate

quantitative analysis into clear, board- and investor-ready narrative.

• Organized, analytical, motivated, curious, resourceful, flexible, and collaborative,

with the judgment to handle market-sensitive and confidential information.

• A self-starter with a proactive attitude who seeks out opportunities for themselves

and the team.

• Strong project and time management skills, comfortable operating in a fast-paced,

deadline-driven, publicly-traded company environment.

YOUR MISSION

As Sales Operations Manager UKI, you will be based in Bucharest and take day-to-day ownership of Revenue Operations support for the UK and Ireland, one of UiPath's major European markets. You will work closely with UKI sales leadership and teams, bringing a practical understanding of how UKI teams operate, communicate, forecast and manage pipeline. Previous experience working with or directly supporting UK and Ireland sales teams is essential.

This is a hands-on role. You will work directly in Salesforce, Excel and reporting tools to understand performance, improve forecasting and pipeline visibility, prepare business reviews and turn data into sensible actions and recommendations. You will be expected to get up and running quickly, manage your work independently and stay close to the detail.

You will be part of the Europe Revenue Operations team and report directly to the Director Revenue Operations Europe, with regular coaching and development support. The role offers meaningful ownership and exposure to the UKI business while remaining a strong growth opportunity for a capable mid-career Revenue Operations professional.

Note: This is a senior Individual Contributor role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Run the core UKI operating rhythm, including weekly forecasting, pipeline reviews, performance analysis, business reviews and action tracking

 - Work directly in Salesforce, Excel and Power BI to analyze pipeline, forecast movement, coverage, conversion, performance and data quality, and explain what is driving the numbers

 - Turn analysis into clear, practical recommendations and follow through with UKI sales leaders and teams on agreed actions and course corrections

 - Build trusted working relationships with UKI stakeholders by communicating clearly, understanding local sales behaviors and providing reliable operational support

 - Support annual and in-year planning, including segmentation, territory design, capacity, quota deployment, resource allocation and target setting

 - Maintain accurate reporting and improve sales productivity, forecast discipline, pipeline hygiene, processes and data quality

 - Coordinate with Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Renewals, Partner and Sales Technology teams to resolve issues and deliver UKI priorities

 - Provide practical guidance to sales teams on processes, systems and operating best practices.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a closely related commercial operations role

 - Excellent written and spoken English and the confidence to build trust and communicate clearly with UKI sales leaders and teams

 - Demonstrable experience working with or directly supporting UK and Ireland sales teams, with a good understanding of UKI market, sales cadence and stakeholder expectations

 - Strong practical experience in forecasting, pipeline analysis, business management and sales performance reporting

 - Advanced hands-on capability in Salesforce and Excel, with experience using Power BI or a similar analytics platform to investigate performance and communicate insights

 - Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from data to practical recommendations and actions

 - Ability to operate independently, manage priorities and deliver reliably while remaining comfortable doing the detailed analytical and operational work personally

 - Experience in a B2B software or SaaS environment is preferred

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager, Focus Accounts (DACH Region)
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



Your mission

You'll be the single accountable owner for post-implementation success on UiPath's most strategic accounts. You'll steer all Professional Services, Partner and Customer Engineering workstreams as one program, govern budgets and roadmaps, and be the customer's go-to counterpart for turning a deployed platform into scaled, measurable business outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role at the intersection of Customer Success and Professional Services. You'll oversee Professional Services delivery as a whole across a dedicated set of strategic accounts, many of them global enterprises with multiple operating entities, shared service centers and implementation partners. You'll report to the Regional Customer Success leader and work as a counterpart to the account team: Account Executive, Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Manager and Professional Services leadership.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

Customer leadership:

 - Act as the customer's primary counterpart for the overall automation program, from the program lead and CoE up to executive sponsors

 - Run the program governance cadence with the customer: steering committees, program reviews, QBRs and executive alignment

 - Build a joint program roadmap with the customer and keep it aligned with their business priorities and UiPath's product direction

 - Escalate and resolve delivery, adoption or relationship risks early, bringing in the right UiPath leaders when needed

Professional Services delivery oversight

 - Own the end-to-end view of all Professional Services delivery on your accounts: scope, timelines, budgets, resourcing and quality across every active SoW.

 - Work with PS project managers, solution architects and engineers to make sure workstreams deliver on time, within budget and to the agreed outcomes

 - Manage the handover from implementation into Day 2 operations, so that delivered solutions are adopted, run stably and scale

 - Prioritize across workstreams and resolve conflicts on scope, dependencies and capacity

Multi-entity program governance

 - Coordinate a federated setup with multiple operating entities, a central CoE or shared service center, and different delivery and support models

 - Align implementation partners and system integrators with UiPath's delivery approach and the customer's governance

 - Create one transparent view of status, risks and decisions across entities, regions and partners

Commercial and contract governance

 - Track SoW budgets and burn, license consumption and prepaid credits, and act early on underuse or expiry

 - Spot scope changes and new needs and bring them to the Account Executive as qualified opportunities

 - Support renewal readiness by documenting delivered value and open commitments

Measurement and reporting

 - Define and track program success metrics: on-time and on-budget delivery, use cases in production, consumption, adoption, value realized and customer satisfaction

 - Report program status, results and risks to the customer and to UiPath leadership in a clear, consistent format

 - Share customer insights and lessons learned with Product, Engineering, PS and Sales to shape wider decisions


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 8+ years in enterprise program management, professional services delivery or customer success leadership, ideally in B2B software or SaaS

 - A track record of leading complex, customer-facing programs with multiple workstreams, budgets and stakeholders, from implementation through to scaled operations

 - Experience overseeing professional services or consulting delivery: SoWs, budgets, resourcing, quality and change control

 - Experience in multi-entity or global organizations, coordinating operating entities, shared service centers and implementation partners

 - Credibility with senior customer stakeholders, including C-level and executive sponsors, and the confidence to run steering committees

 - Solid understanding of the customer lifecycle: implementation, adoption, value realization, renewal and expansion

 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to show progress and business impact

 - Familiarity with automation, AI or enterprise platforms, enough to engage credibly with architects and CoE teams

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and comfort in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Nice to have

 - Background in consulting or Big 4 delivery

 - Certification in PMP, PRINCE2 or SAFe

 - Experience with Salesforce, program management tools (such as Smartsheet, Jira or Asana) and CS platforms (such as Gainsight)
